name: summy
title: Summy
description: Save links, text, and files to Summy, then browse their AI-generated summaries.
author: barlow

preferences.name: sessionToken
preferences.title: Summy Session Token
preferences.description: Your private Summy session token. Raycast stores password preferences in its encrypted local database.

commands.name: save-to-summy
commands.title: Save to Summy
commands.description: Choose a link, text, or files to save and summarise in Summy.

commands.name: browse-summy
commands.title: Browse Summy
commands.description: Browse, search, and open everything saved in Summy.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
